NAME: I2C master verification plan
details: Block 15: garuda_i2c_top, the vendored OpenCores I2C byte and bit controllers behind GARUDA's own register file and the APB shim. Source: GARUDA-I2C-SPEC-001, decisions D-16, D-17, D-21. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. Vendored code is covered as far as master-only use reaches; the rest is waived with the reason.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 2, 0x4000_2000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 PRESCALE sets the SCL divider
details: Offset 0x00, read-write, reset 0, bits 15:0. To be changed only with EN clear or the bus idle. Spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c [R-3]

NAME: ral_access PRESCALE
details: Reset value, read-back, upper bits read 0.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F02 CTRL holds EN and the self-clearing ABORT
details: Offset 0x04. Bit 0 EN enables the core. Bit 1 ABORT abandons the transfer and reads back 0. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c [N-7.5] CTRL reads back EN only

NAME: ral_access CTRL
details: EN read-back; ABORT always reads 0; other bits read 0.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F03 TXDATA holds the byte to send
details: Offset 0x08, read-write, bits 7:0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c [R-3]

NAME: ral_access TXDATA
details: Reset value and read-back.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F04 RXDATA holds the byte received and a read clears RXVALID
details: Offset 0x0C, read-only. The read drops the DMA request and does not start a transfer. Spec [N-6.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-1] [N-6.4]

NAME: sb_rx
details: Every byte read equals the byte the slave agent sent.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_rxdata_read_no_cmd
details: A read of RXDATA never starts bus activity.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F05 CMD starts one transfer and clears itself
details: Offset 0x10, write-only, reads 0. STA bit 0, STO 1, RD 2, WR 3, NACK 4. Spec [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-6.2]

NAME: cg_i2c_cmd.cp_cmd
details: Each of the six listed combinations; RD with WR together and STA with STO together, which the specification does not define.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_bus
details: The slave agent's decoded bus activity equals what the model expects for the command.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F06 A CMD written while a transfer is in progress is refused
details: Ignored, with PSLVERR. Spec [N-6.2b].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [N-6.2b]

NAME: a_cmd_while_tip
details: A write to CMD with TIP set raises PSLVERR and changes no command bit.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F07 A CMD written with EN clear does nothing and does not replay later
details: TIP is not left set, and enabling the block afterwards sends nothing. Defect I2C-6.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-6.3], [N-6.2] no replay

NAME: a_no_replay
details: No START on the bus without a CMD write while EN is set.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F08 STATUS reports the transfer and bus state
details: Offset 0x14, read-only. TIP bit 0, BUSY 1, AL 2 sticky, RXNACK 3, TIMEOUT 4 sticky, RXVALID 5. Spec [N-6.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-6.3] several checks

NAME: sb_status
details: Every STATUS read compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_i2c_status.cp_bits
details: Each bit seen 0 and 1 at a read.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F09 TIMEOUT sets the abandon time and 0 disables it
details: Offset 0x18, read-write, reset 0, bits 15:0 in pclk ticks. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c [R-3]

NAME: ral_access TIMEOUT
details: Reset value and read-back.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F10 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT bit 0 transfer complete, 1 arbitration lost, 2 timeout, 3 NACK, write 1 to clear. DMACTL bit 0 requests on a received byte, bit 1 when ready to send. ID reads 0x6A5D, block 15 and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c reads ID

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F11 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and accesses never wait
details: 0x1C to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, unaligned offsets. PREADY is high in every cycle. Requirements R-3, R-4.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-3], [R-4]; the APB protocol checker is bound - 0 violations

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_i2c_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Each unmapped range read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F12 Reset values
details: All registers 0, both pins released. Requirement R-10.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_i2c [R-10]

NAME: ral_reset
details: Register model reset test.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: B Transfers
details: Spec 7.1, 7.2. Checked by an I2C slave agent that decodes the bus.

NAME: F13 Write to a slave
details: START, address with the write bit, acknowledge, data bytes, STOP. Requirement R-1.
implementation_note: Method: sim (I2C slave agent, scoreboard). Today: tb_i2c [R-1], [N-7.1]

NAME: sb_bus
details: Address, direction, each data byte and the STOP compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F14 Read from a slave with ACK and NACK
details: The master acknowledges every byte except the last, which it NACKs so the slave releases the line. Spec [N-6.2a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-1], [N-6.2a]

NAME: sb_bus
details: The acknowledge bit on each read byte compared with CMD.NACK.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_i2c_xfer.x_dir_len
details: Writes and reads of 1, 2, 8 and more bytes.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F15 Repeated start
details: A second START with no STOP between, for a register read. Spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-1] two STARTs, one STOP

NAME: sb_bus
details: START and STOP counts compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F16 Bus conditions are legal
details: SDA changes only while SCL is low except for START and STOP; START and STOP have their setup and hold times.
implementation_note: Method: sim (protocol checks in the slave agent) + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-1] no SDA change while SCL high

NAME: a_sda_stable_scl_high
details: During a data bit driven by the master SDA does not change while SCL is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F17 SCL is at or below the mode limit
details: Measured period for the recommended PRESCALE values, at or below 100 kHz and 400 kHz. Requirement R-2, spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-2] at 249 and 61

NAME: sb_scl_period
details: The slave agent measures every SCL period.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_i2c_rate.cp_prescale
details: PRESCALE 0, 1, 61, 249, 0xFFFF.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F18 A slave may stretch the clock
details: While SCL is held low by the slave the master waits; it continues when released, if the timeout has not expired. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-8] 20 us stretch

NAME: cg_i2c_stretch.x_where_len
details: Stretch after the address, after a data byte and in the middle of a byte; short, long and just under the timeout.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_bus
details: Model compare with stretching.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F19 BUSY follows START and STOP on the bus
details: Including those of another master. Spec [N-6.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-6.3], [N-9.3]

NAME: sb_status
details: Covered by F08.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F20 A spike shorter than the filter is ignored
details: A one-pclk low pulse on SDA or SCL is not a START. Spec [N-9.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-9.3] on SDA

NAME: cg_i2c_glitch.x_line_width
details: Spikes of 1 pclk and of just under the filter length, on each line, idle and mid-transfer.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: C Errors and recovery
details: Spec 7.4, 7.5. Requirements R-7, R-8.

NAME: F21 A NACK is reported and does not hang the block
details: RXNACK and IRQSTAT bit 3 for an unanswered address and for a refused data byte; a STOP can still be sent and the next transfer works. Requirement R-7.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-7]

NAME: sb_status
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_i2c_nack.cp_where
details: NACK on the address, on the first, a middle and the last data byte.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F22 Arbitration loss
details: AL sets and stays, IRQSTAT bit 1 rises, both lines are released, TIP clears, and a retry from START succeeds. Spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim (second master in the agent). Today: tb_i2c [N-7.4]

NAME: a_al_releases
details: After arbitration loss both output enables are 0 until the next CMD.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: cg_i2c_al.cp_where
details: Arbitration lost in the address, in a data byte and on the acknowledge bit.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F23 The timeout abandons a stalled transfer
details: Both pins released without a STOP, STATUS.TIMEOUT and IRQSTAT bit 2 set, TIP cleared, and the block usable again. Requirement R-8, spec [N-7.5], [N-7.5a].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-8], [N-7.5], [N-7.5a]

NAME: a_tip_bounded
details: With TIMEOUT non-zero TIP is never set for longer than TIMEOUT plus a fixed margin.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_i2c_timeout.x_value_phase
details: TIMEOUT 1, just under and just over one byte time, 0xFFFF; stall in each phase.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F24 ABORT does the same on demand in every phase
details: Both pins released at once, TIP cleared, the core idle afterwards and the next transfer correct. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [N-7.5] in 36 phases

NAME: cg_i2c_abort.cp_phase
details: ABORT in each of the 36 bit positions of a transfer.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: a_abort_releases
details: Both output enables are 0 within a fixed number of pclk of ABORT.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F25 EN cleared in the middle of a transfer
details: Both pins released, TIP cleared, and nothing is replayed when EN is set again. Defect I2C-6.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_i2c [R-8], [N-6.3], [N-6.2]

NAME: a_no_replay
details: Covered by F07.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F26 The core reset has no glitch
details: The vendored controllers are reset from one flop, not from combinational logic on the abort counter. Defect I2C-5.
implementation_note: Method: static (lint). Today: HAL - the GLTASR error is gone

NAME: hal_lint
details: No combinational logic in an asynchronous reset path in this block.
implementation_note: flow/2_static.

NAME: D Pins
details: Spec section 9, requirements R-9, R-10.

NAME: F27 The block never drives a line high
details: The output values are tied to 0; a line is either pulled low or released. Requirement R-9, spec [N-9.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-9] whole-run monitor

NAME: a_never_high
details: i2c_scl_o and i2c_sda_o are 0 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F28 Both lines are released in and out of reset
details: Until firmware starts a transfer. Requirement R-10.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-10]

NAME: a_released_in_reset
details: Both output enables are 0 while preset_n is low and until the first CMD.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: E Interrupts
details: Spec 7.3, requirement R-5.

NAME: F29 Four events are captured and held
details: Transfer complete, arbitration lost, timeout, NACK. irq_o is the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN, held until written 1 to clear. Clearing bit 1 also clears STATUS.AL and clearing bit 2 clears STATUS.TIMEOUT.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-5], [N-7.3], [N-6.3]

NAME: a_irq_held
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: An event in the cycle of its own clear leaves the bit set.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_i2c_irq.x_src_en
details: Each of the four sources with its enable 0 and 1; two sources together.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F DMA
details: Spec 7.7, requirement R-6.

NAME: F30 Request on a received byte and when ready to send
details: DMACTL bit 0 requests while RXVALID is set; bit 1 while EN is set and TIP is clear. No request with EN clear or during a transfer. Each byte still needs its own CMD from firmware.
implementation_note: Method: sim (DMA request agent) + formal. Today: tb_i2c [R-6], [N-7.7]

NAME: a_dma_drop
details: dma_req_o is 0 in the pclk after dma_ack_i and after an RXDATA read.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/i2c/garuda_i2c_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: dma_req_checker
details: One beat per assertion, no stuck request.
implementation_note: tb/common/dma_req_checker.sv, bound today.

NAME: cg_i2c_dma.cp_kind
details: Receive request, transmit request, both enabled.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: G With the rest of the chip
details: Checked at chip level and by connectivity checks.

NAME: F31 Interrupt DMA channel and open-drain pads
details: CLIC ID 16, DMA channel 1, and both pads driven low or released, never high.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + connectivity. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c, t_chip_integ.c

NAME: t_chip_periph
details: I2C part - a register write and read against the slave model at the pads.
implementation_note: sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c, passing.

NAME: conn_i2c
details: Bound assertions at the chip top for the interrupt, request, acknowledge and the two pads.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: H Clock and reset
details: Spec section 9.

NAME: F32 Single clock domain with two asynchronous inputs
details: SCL and SDA are synchronised in the wrapper before the vendored core sees them. Decision D-14.
implementation_note: Method: static (clock-domain check) + sim. Today: no check.

NAME: hal_cdc
details: Both inputs reported as synchronised.
implementation_note: flow/2_static. To run on this block.
